business.name: Example Agent Business
business.hypothesis: A narrow customer will pay for a measurable agent-delivered outcome.
business.icp: Define one buyer with a frequent, expensive problem.
business.pain: Quantify the cost, delay, risk, or missed revenue caused by the problem.
business.offer: Define the outcome, scope, proof, and delivery boundary.
business.pricing: Set a testable price tied to value and delivery economics.
business.channel: Name where the first 100 prospects can be reached.
business.unit_economics: Track revenue, variable delivery cost, human review, and contribution margin.

next_actions.description: Choose one narrow customer/problem pair using docs/BUSINESS_MODELS.md.
